turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll type END MEETING on its own line, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
I have a client call at 4:40, so we have twenty minutes. Owen found out about his zero from his phone, in the middle of a class, and nobody called me. Start with who decided that, and when.
You're welcome. Now answer my question: who decided, and when?
"Ok" isn't an answer. Who entered the zero, and did anyone speak to Owen before it went in?
I'm waiting. If you have nothing to say, I'll say it to the principal instead.
Okay. I'm writing down that you had no answer when I asked who decided. One more chance before I'm in the principal's office: who entered the zero?
